behavior_constraints: CG detecting pAp <= 0 must stop iterating and emit the standard output block (solver, preconditioner, dimension, reordering, iterations so far, residual_norm as true residual of partial x, converged: no, and all x[i]) with empty stderr and exit code 0
BiCGSTAB breakdown (rho near zero or denominator near zero) must stop iterating and emit the standard output block with converged: no and all partial x[i], empty stderr, exit code 0

IC(0) encountering a non-positive diagonal pivot must discard the incomplete factor, fall back to no preconditioner, run the solver with preconditioner: none, and report preconditioner: none in output, with empty stderr and exit code 0
IC(0) fallback applies to CG, BiCGSTAB, and GMRES, including runs that use reordering
--history output up to the breakdown/detection point remains unchanged
All input/CLI validation errors continue to exit non-zero with `error:` on stderr and empty stdout
entities.summary: This round converts numerical failure paths (CG non-PD, BiCGSTAB breakdown, IC0 non-positive pivot) from process-aborting errors into graceful partial-output or fallback-to-none behaviors with exit code 0 and empty stderr, while leaving input validation errors unchanged.

instruction_head:
Code review determined that aborting the process on numerical errors was the wrong design choice. Numerical issues during solving (non-positive-definite detection, BiCGSTAB breakdown) should produce a partial result rather than terminating with only an error message. Input validation errors remain unchanged.
